subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a compact one-line summary, and the requested behavior creates a new public config and Telegram message-lifecycle policy rather than fixing a documented bug.

options.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current collapse-summary lifecycle as the default.

options.title: Keep the collapse-summary lifecycle
options.body: Leave Telegram progress mode as final answer plus compact activity digest and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track the checklist requirement in a broader structured progress-card design so Telegram and sibling channels can share the presentation contract.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current collapse-summary lifecycle as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Ayaan Zaidi is listed as the Telegram subsystem owner and has recent commits on the progress-draft dispatcher surface.
